input: Finite binary64 components are rounded to binary32 nearest-ties-even and widened exactly to binary64 before arithmetic. A non-finite quantized value fails.
rounding: R rounds each elementary arithmetic operation, including sqrt, to binary64 nearest-ties-even; Q rounds to binary32 nearest-ties-even and widens exactly. No FMA, reassociation, pairwise reduction, intermediate f32 fold, score clamping or arbitrary magnitude ceiling substitutes for this law.
dimension_order: Increasing component index; every additive fold begins at positive zero.
member_order: Ascending semantic member identity, independently for each output dimension.

operations.dot: s = fold_i R(s + R(a[i] * b[i])); return s.
operations.cosine: Compute dot, L = fold_i R(L + R(a[i]*a[i])), H = fold_i R(H + R(b[i]*b[i])). If L=0 or H=0 return +0; otherwise return R(dot / R(R(sqrt(L)) * R(sqrt(H)))).
operations.l2: d[i] = R(a[i]-b[i]); s = fold_i R(s + R(d[i]*d[i])); return -R(sqrt(s)).
operations.normalize: s = fold_i R(s + R(a[i]*a[i])); n = R(sqrt(s)); n=0 fails; output[i] = Q(R(a[i]/n)).
operations.pool_sum: For each dimension, s = fold_members R(s + component); return Q(s).
operations.pool_mean: For each dimension, s = fold_members R(s + component); return Q(R(s/member_count)).
operations.pool_max: For each dimension return the maximum present quantized member component; no infinite sentinel is an operand.
operations.weighted_merge: Missing score contributions are +0; return R(R(left_weight*left_score) + R(right_weight*right_score)). No present-only weight renormalization.
operations.max_merge: Return the maximum of present scores only. Missing scores are not zero operands.

failure: Every quantization, elementary intermediate and final conversion must be finite. Invalid input is rejected before scoring or output truncation.
zero: Cosine with either quantized zero vector returns +0; normalization of a quantized zero vector fails. Canonicalize every emitted zero scalar/component to +0, preserving internal IEEE signed-zero arithmetic.
empty_pool: No member groups means no output vectors; no zero-member group is invented.
output: Vector components are finally rounded with Q; scores remain binary64.
